title: Sandra Lambert
summary: Sandra Lambert is a Seeker and retired member of the Huntik Foundation. The wife of Eathon Lambert and mother to Lok Lambert and Kathy Lambert, Sandra lives in County Kerry, Ireland.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Sandra met Eathon Lambert and the pair eventually married and had two children, Kathy and Lok. Eathon once took Sandra for a picnic in the valley of Tír na nÓg to which she gave him a smack as he had promised he'd retired from adventuring. [Back Home] After Eathon disappeared, Sandra was left to raise her children on her own. [Home Turf]

The Huntik team stayed with Sandra at the Lambert house while on vacation. Sandra spoke to Dante about how she missed Eathon and how she couldn't bear to lose Lok too. After the team traveled to Newgrange Passage Tomb with Scarlet Byrne, Sandra came to Lok's rescue and helped defeat Klaus' Suits. [Home Turf]

Lok revealed to Cherit in the Tomb of Nefertiti that Sandra had got him a bird when he was six, contrary to the bicycle, baseball bat and toy he had wanted. This became key to solving the puzzle and recovering Eathon Lambert's puzzle. [The Sceptre Deception]

The team stayed as Sandra's again after being defeated by Rassimov in Egypt. [Back Home]

During the final battle, Sandra secretly joined Scarlet as a co-pilot on a Scramjet despite being retired. [The Spiral Mark] She was shocked to hear of Dante's death and joined the battle against the Blood Spiral. [Lok and the Betrayer] During the final battle against The Betrayer, Sandra fought alongside Lucas Casterwill but both were paralyzed by the Betrayer's Shadowlock power. After his defeat, Sandra was freed and celebrated the triumph. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Sandra is a very caring person, and an even more caring mother. She will do anything to make sure her children are okay, and will protect them at all costs. {{Source|Lok and the Betrayer}} She is quite upbeat, and like most mothers, she will happily embarrass her children in front of their friends. She also supports Lok's decision to become a Seeker even though she knows it is a dangerous profession. {{Source|Home Turf}} In her youth she seemed to be rather quick-tempered as she slapped Eathon for breaking his promise not to go to [[Tír na nÓg]]. {{Source|Back Home}}

full_text:
Sandra Lambert is a Seeker and retired member of the Huntik Foundation. The wife of Eathon Lambert and mother to Lok Lambert and Kathy Lambert, Sandra lives in County Kerry, Ireland.

History

Sandra met Eathon Lambert and the pair eventually married and had two children, Kathy and Lok. Eathon once took Sandra for a picnic in the valley of Tír na nÓg to which she gave him a smack as he had promised he'd retired from adventuring. [Back Home] After Eathon disappeared, Sandra was left to raise her children on her own. [Home Turf]

The Huntik team stayed with Sandra at the Lambert house while on vacation. Sandra spoke to Dante about how she missed Eathon and how she couldn't bear to lose Lok too. After the team traveled to Newgrange Passage Tomb with Scarlet Byrne, Sandra came to Lok's rescue and helped defeat Klaus' Suits. [Home Turf]

Lok revealed to Cherit in the Tomb of Nefertiti that Sandra had got him a bird when he was six, contrary to the bicycle, baseball bat and toy he had wanted. This became key to solving the puzzle and recovering Eathon Lambert's puzzle. [The Sceptre Deception]

The team stayed as Sandra's again after being defeated by Rassimov in Egypt. [Back Home]

During the final battle, Sandra secretly joined Scarlet as a co-pilot on a Scramjet despite being retired. [The Spiral Mark] She was shocked to hear of Dante's death and joined the battle against the Blood Spiral. [Lok and the Betrayer] During the final battle against The Betrayer, Sandra fought alongside Lucas Casterwill but both were paralyzed by the Betrayer's Shadowlock power. After his defeat, Sandra was freed and celebrated the triumph. [Dante's Return]

Personality

Sandra is a very caring person, and an even more caring mother. She will do anything to make sure her children are okay, and will protect them at all costs. [Lok and the Betrayer] She is quite upbeat, and like most mothers, she will happily embarrass her children in front of their friends. She also supports Lok's decision to become a Seeker even though she knows it is a dangerous profession. [Home Turf] In her youth she seemed to be rather quick-tempered as she slapped Eathon for breaking his promise not to go to Tír na nÓg. [Back Home]
